query: I'm getting ready for an intense training trip and need to order some gear. First, I'm looking for something from the brand Vans in a size 38; I want to make sure it’s a good product, so it must have fewer than 30 two-star reviews. To go with that, I need a new 'Training Top'. It has to be highly rated, with an average score over 4.5, more than 40 four-star reviews, and a stock quantity of more than 100. Since the trip is soon, I need two other items with a transport time of less than two days. I’m looking for a size XL item from Arc'teryx with 'Alpine' in its name and more than 20 four-star reviews. Lastly, I also need a Ralph Lauren product, also in size XL with that fast shipping, but this one must have fewer than 20 three-star ratings. I'm looking for something that costs somewhere in the range of 3546 to 3561.
